title: Page card, L1 (v0.2 MVP subset)
description: One per normalized URL: what the page answers, where on the page, and how to get it. Pointers, not a copy of the page.

id.description: page:<normalized host + path>. Set by the registry from url; any value sent is replaced.

answers.description: One line: the topics the whole page covers. Not the question that led here, and no values

sections.description: The page's main sections: anchor (e.g. '#rate-limits') or heading text -> the settings, limits or items it covers, not their values

route.description: The cheapest way to get this page's content: the smallest source that has it and the fetch arguments that worked

url.description: Raw source file, API endpoint, Markdown version, or the page itself if nothing smaller exists

section.description: A section= value that works on the route url

start.description: A start offset that reaches the relevant part

tokens.description: Approximate size of what the route returns

notes.description: What did not work and why, e.g. section= fails because entries are not headings

access.description: Access notes for this page only

md_version.description: URL of a Markdown version of this page

api.description: API URL returning this page's data

links.description: Links worth following from this page

size_tokens.description: Approximate size of the cleaned page in tokens. Set by the registry when it can fetch the page.

content_hash.description: Set by the registry; any value sent is replaced.

observed_at.description: ISO date the page was checked
